CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_own_obligations_owner(p_partner_id uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE u uuid:=auth.uid(); s record; owner uuid;
BEGIN
 IF u IS NULL OR NOT platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(u)
  OR NOT public.has_role(u,'parceiro_b2b') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'own_finance_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF NOT public.is_valid_b2b_partner_user(u,p_partner_id) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'own_finance_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT pa.commercial_owner_organization_id INTO owner FROM public.partner_accounts pa
 JOIN public.partner_users pu ON pu.partner_id=pa.id
 JOIN public.profiles pf ON pf.user_id=pu.user_id
 JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id=pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
 WHERE pa.id=p_partner_id AND pu.user_id=u
 AND pu.revoked_at IS NULL AND pu.valid_from<=now()
 AND pf.ativo AND o.ativo AND o.status='ativa' AND pa.ativo AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
 AND pf.organization_id=pu.tenant_id AND pu.tenant_id=o.id
 AND public.h15_actor_organization()=o.id;
 IF owner IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.entitlements_for_user(u) e WHERE e.feature_key='pedidos_b2b')
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.entitlements_for_user(u) e WHERE e.feature_key='contas_receber') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'own_finance_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN owner;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_portal_partner_financial(p_partner_id uuid, p_own_finance_v1 boolean, p_before timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_before_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql

 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF p_own_finance_v1 IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'own_finance_contract_required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN platform_private.b2b_own_obligations(p_partner_id,p_before,p_before_id);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2_order_internal_recipients(_partner uuid)
 RETURNS SETOF uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT DISTINCT ur.user_id
    FROM public.partner_accounts pa
    JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id = pa.commercial_owner_organization_id AND o.ativo IS TRUE AND o.status = 'ativa'
    JOIN public.profiles p ON p.organization_id = o.id AND p.ativo IS TRUE
    JOIN public.user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = p.user_id
   WHERE pa.id = _partner AND pa.ativo IS TRUE AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
     AND ur.role IN ('administrador'::public.app_role,'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fiscal_requirement_resolve(p_sales_channel text, p_operation_type text, p_uf text, p_scope_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_scope_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_ref_date date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_ex record; v_pol record;
BEGIN
  IF p_scope_type IS NOT NULL AND p_scope_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT * INTO v_ex FROM public.fiscal_requirement_exemptions
     WHERE active AND scope_type = p_scope_type AND scope_id = p_scope_id LIMIT 1;
    IF FOUND THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('required', false, 'status','EXEMPT', 'source','exemption',
        'exemption_id', v_ex.id, 'motivo', v_ex.motivo, 'approved_by', v_ex.approved_by);
    END IF;
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_pol FROM public.fiscal_operation_policies
   WHERE active AND sales_channel = p_sales_channel AND operation_type = p_operation_type
     AND (uf IS NULL OR uf = p_uf)
     AND valid_from <= p_ref_date AND (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until >= p_ref_date)
   ORDER BY (uf IS NOT NULL) DESC, valid_from DESC LIMIT 1;

  IF FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('required', v_pol.requires_invoice,
      'status', CASE WHEN v_pol.requires_invoice THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'NOT_REQUIRED' END,
      'source','policy','policy_id', v_pol.id, 'document_model', v_pol.document_model);
  END IF;

  -- Fail-closed: nunca assume NOT_REQUIRED em silêncio
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('required', true, 'status','PENDING_PARAMETRIZATION',
    'source','pending_parametrization', 'policy_id', NULL,
    'motivo','Nenhuma política fiscal cadastrada para o canal/operação/UF — parametrização contábil pendente');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_report_payables(_filters jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(installment_id uuid, payable_id uuid, supplier text, description text, category text, due_date date, amount numeric, paid numeric, balance numeric, status text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE _from date := (_filters->>'from')::date;
        _to date := (_filters->>'to')::date;
        _status text := _filters->>'status';
BEGIN
  IF NOT is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT i.id, ap.id, COALESCE(ap.supplier_name,'—'), ap.description, fc.name,
         i.due_date, i.original_amount,
         COALESCE(i.paid_amount,0),
         i.original_amount - COALESCE(i.paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(i.discount_amount,0),
         i.status
  FROM accounts_payable_installments i
  JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = i.payable_id
  LEFT JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ap.category_id
  WHERE (_from IS NULL OR i.due_date >= _from)
    AND (_to IS NULL OR i.due_date <= _to)
    AND (_status IS NULL OR i.status = _status)
    AND ap.status <> 'CANCELED'
  ORDER BY i.due_date;
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_partner_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
           WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE pu.revoked_at IS NULL) <> 1 THEN NULL
           WHEN bool_or(pa.ativo IS TRUE AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
                        AND pa.commercial_owner_organization_id IS NOT NULL
                        AND pu.tenant_id IS NOT NULL
                        AND pu.tenant_id = pa.commercial_owner_organization_id)
                FILTER (WHERE pu.revoked_at IS NULL)
           THEN (array_agg(pu.partner_id) FILTER (WHERE pu.revoked_at IS NULL))[1]
         END
  FROM public.partner_users pu
  LEFT JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id = pu.partner_id
  WHERE pu.user_id = auth.uid();
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_financial_staff(_uid uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.fn_authz_uid_scope_ok(_uid) THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;
  RETURN has_role(_uid, 'administrador'::app_role)
      OR has_role(_uid, 'gestor'::app_role)
      OR has_role(_uid, 'financeiro'::app_role);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2_attempt_dispatch_guard(p_uid uuid, p_partner uuid, p_key text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET lock_timeout TO '5s'
AS $function$
DECLARE org uuid; j platform_private.partner_order_attempt_journal;
BEGIN
 org := platform_private.c2_attempt_scope_lock(p_uid,p_partner);
 SELECT * INTO j FROM platform_private.partner_order_attempt_journal
 WHERE actor_id=p_uid AND organization_id=org AND partner_id=p_partner ORDER BY generation DESC LIMIT 1;
 IF j.idempotency_key IS DISTINCT FROM p_key OR p_key IS NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2DJ_REGISTERED_ATTEMPT_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_b2b_apply_interest(p_net numeric, p_interest_type text, p_monthly_pct numeric, p_months numeric)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN p_interest_type = 'none' OR COALESCE(p_monthly_pct,0) = 0 OR COALESCE(p_months,0) = 0
      THEN ROUND(p_net,2)
    WHEN p_interest_type = 'simple'
      THEN ROUND(p_net * (1 + (p_monthly_pct/100.0) * p_months), 2)
    ELSE ROUND(p_net * POWER(1 + (p_monthly_pct/100.0), p_months), 2)
  END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_b2b_cart_hash(p_partner_id uuid, p_plan_id uuid, p_cart jsonb, p_final numeric)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(
    'v2|' || COALESCE(p_partner_id::text,'-') || '|' || COALESCE(p_plan_id::text,'-') || '|' ||
    to_char(ROUND(COALESCE(p_final,0),2),'FM9999999999990.00') || '|' ||
    COALESCE((
      SELECT string_agg(
        COALESCE(l->>'item_tipo','')      || '~' ||
        COALESCE(l->>'item_id','')        || '~' ||
        COALESCE(l->>'unidade_medida','') || '~' ||
        to_char(ROUND(COALESCE((l->>'volume_ml')::numeric,0),4),'FM9999999999990.0000') || '~' ||
        to_char(ROUND(COALESCE((l->>'quantidade')::numeric,0),4),'FM9999999999990.0000') || '~' ||
        COALESCE(l->>'pricing_mode','')   || '~' ||
        COALESCE(l->>'price_source','')   || '~' ||
        COALESCE(l->>'rule_id','')        || '~' ||
        to_char(ROUND(COALESCE((l->>'final_unit_price')::numeric,0),4),'FM9999999999990.0000') || '~' ||
        to_char(ROUND(COALESCE((l->>'line_final_amount')::numeric,0),2),'FM9999999999990.00'),
        ';' ORDER BY COALESCE(l->>'item_tipo',''),
                     COALESCE(l->>'item_id',''),
                     COALESCE(l->>'unidade_medida',''),
                     COALESCE((l->>'volume_ml')::numeric,0),
                     COALESCE((l->>'quantidade')::numeric,0),
                     COALESCE(l->>'rule_id',''))
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(p_cart->'lines','[]'::jsonb)) l
    ),'') || '|' ||
    COALESCE((p_cart->>'quote_required'),'false')
  ,'UTF8')),'hex')
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_h6b_payment_fingerprint(p_kind text, p_installment_id uuid, p_payload jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
  SELECT encode(extensions.digest(
    concat_ws('|',
      'v1', p_kind, p_installment_id::text,
      public.fn_h6b_num(COALESCE((p_payload->>'amount_received')::numeric,
                                 (p_payload->>'amount_paid')::numeric)),
      public.fn_h6b_num((p_payload->>'discount_amount')::numeric),
      public.fn_h6b_num((p_payload->>'interest_amount')::numeric),
      public.fn_h6b_num((p_payload->>'penalty_amount')::numeric),
      COALESCE(NULLIF(p_payload->>'payment_method_id',''), '-'),
      COALESCE(NULLIF(p_payload->>'bank_account_id',''), '-'),
      COALESCE(NULLIF(p_payload->>'payment_date',''), '-'),
      COALESCE(NULLIF(p_payload->>'notes',''), '-'),
      COALESCE(NULLIF(p_payload->>'has_receipt',''), '-')
    ), 'sha256'), 'hex');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_h6_guard_title_snapshot()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.total_amount IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.total_amount
     OR NEW.installment_count IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.installment_count
     OR NEW.origin_type IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.origin_type
     OR NEW.origin_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.origin_id
     OR NEW.issue_date IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.issue_date
     OR NEW.first_due_date IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.first_due_date
     OR NEW.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_by
     OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Snapshot financeiro imutavel: valor, parcelas, origem e datas de emissao nao podem ser alterados.'
      USING ERRCODE='check_violation';
  END IF;

  IF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'accounts_receivable'
     AND (to_jsonb(NEW)->>'payment_method_id') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)->>'payment_method_id') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Condicao/metodo do titulo e imutavel apos a criacao: use o metodo na baixa (receivable_payments).'
      USING ERRCODE='check_violation';
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_h6_guard_ar_installment_snapshot()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.receivable_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.receivable_id
     OR NEW.installment_number IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.installment_number
     OR NEW.original_amount IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.original_amount
     OR NEW.due_date IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.due_date
     OR NEW.net_amount IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.net_amount
     OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Parcela imutavel: titulo, numero, valor original, vencimento, valor liquido e data de criacao nao podem ser alterados.'
      USING ERRCODE='check_violation';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2p1_settings_fence()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' OR NOT platform_private.c2p1_settings_allowed(NEW.partner_id,true)
 OR NOT platform_private.has_ticket('c2p1_settings_write',NEW.partner_id) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_SETTINGS_WRITE_CLOSED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND (NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id OR NEW.partner_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.partner_id
 OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_IDENTITY_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.payment_methods WHERE active IS TRUE AND name=NEW.default_payment_method)<>1
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_PAYMENT_METHOD_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 IF NEW.credit_limit::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR NEW.credit_limit<0
 OR NEW.credit_alert_threshold_1::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
 OR NEW.credit_alert_threshold_2::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
 OR NEW.credit_alert_threshold_1 NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100 OR NEW.credit_alert_threshold_2 NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100
 OR NEW.credit_alert_threshold_1>NEW.credit_alert_threshold_2
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_FINANCIAL_VALUES_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_governance_audit()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_partner uuid;
BEGIN
  v_partner := CASE WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='partner_financial_settings' THEN COALESCE(NEW.partner_id, OLD.partner_id) ELSE NULL END;
  INSERT INTO financial_governance_audit_log(usuario_id, partner_id, acao, dados_anteriores, dados_novos)
  VALUES (auth.uid(), v_partner,
    TG_TABLE_NAME || '_' || lower(TG_OP),
    CASE WHEN TG_OP IN ('UPDATE','DELETE') THEN to_jsonb(OLD) END,
    CASE WHEN TG_OP IN ('INSERT','UPDATE') THEN to_jsonb(NEW) END);
  RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_block_pofl_delete()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- Rollback controlado: somente administrador e somente apos cancelamento
  -- canonico do recebivel (cancel_b2b_receivable_secure).
  IF COALESCE(OLD.financial_status, '') = 'cancelado'
     AND auth.uid() IS NOT NULL
     AND public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::app_role) THEN
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Vínculo financeiro não pode ser excluído';
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_audit_partner_order_commercial()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.priority IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.priority OR NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status THEN
    INSERT INTO public.commercial_audit_log(usuario_id, partner_id, order_id, acao, dados_anteriores, dados_novos)
    VALUES (
      auth.uid(), NEW.partner_id, NEW.id, 'partner_orders.commercial_change',
      jsonb_build_object('status', OLD.status, 'priority', OLD.priority),
      jsonb_build_object('status', NEW.status, 'priority', NEW.priority)
    );
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_block_partner_order_edit_after_op()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_locked boolean;
BEGIN
  v_locked := public.partner_order_has_production(OLD.id);
  IF NOT v_locked THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  -- Campos sempre permitidos
  -- status, ready_for_production, approved_by, approved_at, approval_notes,
  -- estimated_delivery_date, observacoes, updated_at, future_financial_link

  IF NEW.subtotal IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.subtotal
     OR NEW.desconto_total IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.desconto_total
     OR NEW.total IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.total
     OR NEW.partner_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.partner_id
     OR NEW.numero IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.numero
     OR NEW.requested_delivery_date IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.requested_delivery_date
  THEN
    INSERT INTO public.partner_order_audit_logs (order_id, partner_id, usuario_id, acao, dados_anteriores, dados_novos)
    VALUES (OLD.id, OLD.partner_id, auth.uid(), 'edicao_bloqueada',
            to_jsonb(OLD), to_jsonb(NEW));
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Este pedido já possui Ordem de Produção vinculada e não pode mais ser alterado.';
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_partner_order_to_planning_fn()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.ready_for_production = true AND (OLD.ready_for_production IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.ready_for_production) THEN
    INSERT INTO public.production_planning (partner_order_id, partner_id, status, created_by)
    VALUES (NEW.id, NEW.partner_id, 'aguardando_planejamento', NEW.approved_by)
    ON CONFLICT (partner_order_id) DO NOTHING;

    INSERT INTO public.production_timeline_events (partner_order_id, event_type, actor_id, meta)
    VALUES (NEW.id, 'planejamento_criado', NEW.approved_by, jsonb_build_object('approved_at', NEW.approved_at));
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2_accounting_pending_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- While pending, only commercial review/quote, rejection or cancellation are possible: no approval,
 -- credit decision, economics seal, receivable, production, NF or delivery.
 -- INSERT: the canonical create may land in em_analise_comercial, aguardando_cotacao or (insufficient credit)
 -- aguardando_aprovacao_credito; nothing operational/financial may be set at creation.
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
  IF NEW.c2_external_origin_snapshot->>'contract'='C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_REQUEST_PENDING_ACCOUNTING_V1' AND (
     NEW.status::text NOT IN ('em_analise_comercial','aguardando_cotacao','aguardando_aprovacao_credito')
     OR NEW.ready_for_production IS TRUE OR NEW.receivable_generated IS TRUE OR NEW.internal_economic_snapshot IS NOT NULL
     OR NEW.credit_approved_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.approved_at IS NOT NULL) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2_ACCOUNTING_PENDING' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 IF OLD.c2_external_origin_snapshot->>'contract'='C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_REQUEST_PENDING_ACCOUNTING_V1'
    AND NEW.c2_external_origin_snapshot->>'contract'='C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_REQUEST_PENDING_ACCOUNTING_V1' THEN
  -- aguardando_aprovacao_credito may only stay as is (no hidden credit decision) or leave to cancel/reject.
  IF NOT (NEW.status::text IN ('em_analise_comercial','aguardando_cotacao','cancelado','reprovado')
          OR (NEW.status=OLD.status AND OLD.status::text='aguardando_aprovacao_credito'))
     OR (OLD.status::text='aguardando_aprovacao_credito' AND NEW.status::text IN ('em_analise_comercial','aguardando_cotacao'))
     OR NEW.ready_for_production IS TRUE OR NEW.receivable_generated IS TRUE OR NEW.internal_economic_snapshot IS NOT NULL
     OR NEW.credit_approved_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.credit_approved_at OR NEW.approved_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approved_at
     -- review e1e9aa2f: no credit/financial decision field may advance by any privileged path while pending.
     OR NEW.credit_approved_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.credit_approved_by OR NEW.credit_approval_notes IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.credit_approval_notes
     OR NEW.approved_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approved_by
     -- review 61b28: the canonical create (same txn, private create ticket) initializes not_required -> pending/not_required;
     -- any other change (e.g. -> approved) is a financial decision and stays denied while pending.
     OR (NEW.financial_approval_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.financial_approval_status
         AND NOT (platform_private.has_ticket('c2_external_order_create',NEW.partner_id)
                  AND OLD.financial_approval_status='not_required' AND NEW.financial_approval_status IN ('pending','not_required'))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2_ACCOUNTING_PENDING' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2_external_final_state_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.c2_external_origin_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND OLD.internal_economic_snapshot IS NULL AND NEW.internal_economic_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'aprovado' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2_EXTERNAL_UNFINALIZED_APPROVAL' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_h6_payments_append_only()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    IF public.fn_h6d_hard_delete_allowed() THEN
      RETURN OLD;
    END IF;
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Baixa financeira nao pode ser excluida: use estorno (fn_reverse_payment).'
      USING ERRCODE='check_violation';
  END IF;
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Baixa financeira e imutavel: use estorno (fn_reverse_payment).'
    USING ERRCODE='check_violation';
END $function$
